proposal: AAE offline learned forward surrogate with exact native verification and classical fallback
training_source: Only generated native AAE impulse responses; no measured/private recording used for training
profile: wet-only, unmodulated, non-adaptive, input diffusion/envelopment/height fixed to 0.7/0.7/0.5
feature_domain: 16 kHz analysis, 8-second finite observation, seven normalized reverse-energy curves at 32 times, clipped below -40 dB; explicit 2 ms direct exclusion
quality_gate: Native profile RMSE <= 3 dB is an engineering match proxy, not perceptual or calibrated room quality
selection: Development loss only; freeze weights and hash before reading/scoring final holdout
baseline: Physics-derived, default and native dictionary seeds; identical native evaluation budgets for neural/classical comparisons
measured_data: Local L/R WAVs inspected but not established as deconvolved IRs; excluded. Public dataset provenance still being checked.
scope: AAE remains implementation in progress until model/native fit, measured-domain and other quality/host requirements have evidence; full 31-plugin/5-program audit unchanged.
control_coordinates: Logarithmic room_size/rt60/bass_ratio/treble_ratio, linear predelay and ER fraction; early/late levels sum to one during identification.
measurement_admission: At least 25 dB observed decay coverage in three curves; missing future observations are masked and not fabricated silence.
